parsing_rules.Age: Convert textual numbers like 'thirty' to numeric string '30'; empty or unparseable values to null
parsing_rules.Salary: Convert textual numbers like 'SIXTY THOUSAND' to numeric string '60000'; 'NAN' or empty to null; otherwise parse as integer
parsing_rules.Joining Date: Parse various date formats (M/D/YYYY, MM/DD/YYYY, DD-MMM-YY, YYYY.MM.DD) and convert to DD/MM/YYYY format; empty to null

missing_value_policy.Other columns: preserve original or empty string if missing
